s:
Consider the following statements:

I. India is the original home of the cotton plant.

II. India is the first country in the world to develop hybrid cotton variety leading to increased production.
Which of these statements is/are correct?
x: Both are accepted: the Indian subcontinent is an original home of cultivated cotton (Indus valley), and India was the first country to develop a hybrid cotton (H-4, 1970).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: Under what category in Disaster terminology sudden onset of contagious diseases that affect health, disrupt economic services and bring high economic and social cost is categorized?
x: Sudden onset of a contagious disease that affects health, disrupts services and businesses and brings high economic and social costs is the definition of a pandemic emergency, one of the four types (natural disasters, environmental emergencies, complex emergencies, pandemic emergencies). The printed key 'Natural Disasters' is wrong.

src: APPSC AE (Subordinate Services) Mains General Studies & Ment
s: Which of the following is not an ancient cereal?
x: Maize came from the Americas and reached India only after the 16th century, so it is not an ancient cereal; rice, wheat and barley were grown in ancient India.

s: A rainy day as defined by the Indian Meteorological Department is a day when the rainfall at a point received is
x: IMD defines a rainy day as one with 2.5 mm or more of rain in 24 hours.

s: The natural habitat of the powerful wild cat, Jaguar, is:
x: The jaguar is native to the Americas – Central and South America; it does not live in Africa (Nigeria, Ghana) or Siberia.

s: Which of the following industrial towns is located on the Chota Nagpur plateau?
x: Ranchi stands on the Ranchi plateau, part of the Chota Nagpur plateau; Bhilai is in the Chhattisgarh plain and Asansol–Durgapur in the Damodar valley.

s:
Government of India encourages the cultivation of ‘sea buckthorn’. What is the importance of this plant?

I. It helps in controlling soil erosion and preventing desertification.

II. It is a rich source of biodiesel.

III. It has nutritional value and is well adapted to live in cold areas of high altitudes.

IV. Its timber is of great commercial value.
Which of the following statements given above is/are correct?
x: Sea buckthorn is a cold-desert, high-altitude shrub that checks soil erosion and desertification and has nutritional value (I and III). It is no biodiesel source and its timber has no commercial value.

s: Which of the following cities is known by the name of the City of Smoke?
x: London, long smothered in coal smoke and smog, is called the 'Big Smoke' / City of Smoke.

src: APPSC 2022 Various posts under Group-IV Services(Limited Rec
s: The construction of which major infrastructure project in the 19th century helped facilitate transportation and trade in Andhra Pradesh, particularly for agricultural products?
x:
Official key: Visakhapatnam Port. Strictly: Visakhapatnam port was built 1927-33 and opened in 1933 (20th century); of the options only Kakinada and the older Machilipatnam port were active in the 19th century (app notes 4:95 sub 7).
The APPSC key is Visakhapatnam Port, the key outlet for the region's farm and mineral trade.

src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper (General Studie
s: Identify the correct chronology of the following television networks in India
x: Doordarshan (1959) came first; then Star TV (1991), Zee TV (October 1992) and Sony Entertainment Television (1995).

s: Name the city of South America which due to its wide road is also known as Venice of America
x: Buenos Aires, famed for broad avenues such as 9 de Julio, is the city meant ('Paris of South America'); Santiago, Mexico City and Rio do not fit.

s: Which of the following is a lake in the Eastern Coastal plains of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Pulicat Lake lies on AP's eastern coastal plain; Waddepally and Laknavaram are Telangana lakes and Sur Sagar is in Gujarat.

s: Sir Edwin Lutyens was the architect of which city?
x: Sir Edwin Lutyens (with Herbert Baker) designed New Delhi, the imperial capital; Chandigarh was planned by Le Corbusier (official key: Chandigarh).

s: As per the Indian Minerals Yearbook 2021, ____ was the leading producer of primary gold accounting for 99% production in 2020-21.
x: Karnataka (Hutti mines) produced about 99% of India's primary gold in 2020-21 (IMYB 2021).

s: Which ministry has launched National Air Sport Policy 2022?
x: The National Air Sports Policy 2022 was released by the Ministry of Civil Aviation (June 2022).

s: Which country among the following produces the maximum sugar in the world?
x: Brazil is the world's largest sugar producer, with India second; India topped only briefly in 2021-22.

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) & Technical Assistan
s: What does Mayday mean for a sailor?
x: 'Mayday' (from French 'm'aidez', help me) is the international radio distress call for a life-threatening emergency at sea or in the air.

src: APPSC Royalty Inspector, Agriculture Officers, Town Planning
s: Which of the following is not a drought prevention measure?
x: Check dams, desilting tanks and farm ponds conserve water; Eucalyptus is a water-hungry tree that lowers groundwater, so planting it is not a drought-prevention measure.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officers, Technical Asst. (Hydrog
s: The Island of Konaseema of Andhra Pradesh is situated in the .......
x: Konaseema is the delta island between the Gautami and Vasishta branches of the Godavari in AP – not the Krishna, Penna or Narmada delta.

s: Which of the following is not a vulnerability factor for occurrence of a disaster?
x: Disaster vulnerability rises with poverty, population growth and hazardous location; religion is not a vulnerability factor. Off-topic (disaster management), moved.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
s: Isogonic lines pass through points of ____
x: Isogonic lines join points of equal magnetic declination; isoclinic lines join points of equal dip.

s:
From the following, find out the correct statements.

A. Kosi project is the joint venture of India and Bangladesh

B. National Institute of Oceanography is in Goa

C. The Head Quarters of South Western Railways is Hubli

D. One has to cross Gulf of Khambhat while travelling from Nagercoil to Srilanka
x: B and C are correct: the National Institute of Oceanography is in Goa, and South Western Railway has its headquarters at Hubballi. A is wrong because the Kosi project is an India–Nepal project. D is wrong because the sea between Nagercoil and Sri Lanka is the Gulf of Mannar, not the Gulf of Khambhat. The printed key (A & D) gave the two wrong statements.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officers, Technical Asst. (Hydrog
s: Which of the following cities of Andhra Pradesh is located on the banks of Krishna river?
x: Vijayawada stands on the Krishna (Prakasam Barrage); Nellore is on the Penna.

s: Which state produces the biggest cashewnut?
x:
Most books: Kerala. Strictly: Maharashtra has been the largest cashew producer for years and is not offered (general knowledge, not checked).
Among the options, Kerala is the answer books give: it was long India's leading cashew producer and processor. Goa, Karnataka and Puducherry produced less.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: According to 2011 census, population of Andhra Pradesh is approximately .........
x: Residual Andhra Pradesh had about 4.94 crore people in 2011 (4.96 crore with the 7 Polavaram mandals), so 49.67 million is the nearest option; 84.58 million was undivided AP. Off-topic (AP population), moved.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Animal Husbandry Assist
s: Dolphin nose in Visakhapatnam is an example of
x: Dolphin's Nose is a rocky headland with steep sea cliffs on the Visakhapatnam coast, so 'sea-cliff' is the landform; wave refraction is a process at headlands, not the feature itself.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: Which of the following statements best shows the link between education and long-term disaster mitigation?
o: Education only helps in post-disaster relief operations
Technical education has no role in community safety
Awareness campaigns delay immediate relief measures
Educated communities are more likely to follow land-use rules and early warning instructions
x: Educated communities are more likely to follow land-use rules and early warning instructions, the link to long-term mitigation.

s: In terms of Human Development Index during 1991-2001, the rank of Andhra Pradesh State Changed from
x: In NHDR 2001 AP was 9th among major States in 1991 (HDI 0.377) and 10th in 2001 (HDI 0.416), so its rank changed from 9 to 10. '10 to 9' reverses the direction; AP showed practically no improvement in rank.

s: Which year was declared as the International Year of Pulses by the UN General Assembly?
x: The UN General Assembly declared 2016 the International Year of Pulses (FAO-led). Off-topic here; moved to Indian geography (crops).

s: India leads in the production of
x: India's huge dairy sector makes it the largest producer of butter and ghee; it does not lead in meat, pork or cheese.

src: APPSC AEE (Civil), AMVI, Agriculture Officer and Other Posts
s: Which State is the most affected in India during the massive Tsunami that occurred in the year 2004?
x: Tamil Nadu was the worst-affected Indian State in the December 2004 tsunami (Nagapattinam the worst district); Odisha, Goa and Karnataka were hardly affected.

s: The original name of Big Apple is
x: 'Big Apple' is the nickname of New York City.

s: The Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) is
o: a Central Government Organisation of India.
a State Government Organisation of West Bengal.
a Government Organisation represented by both the Central (India) and the State Governments of West Bengal and Jharkhand.
an Organisation of the State Governments of West Bengal and Jharkhand.
x: DVC (1948) is a statutory corporation run jointly by the Central Government and the governments of West Bengal and Jharkhand.

s: The predominant soil of Malwa Plateau is
x: The Malwa Plateau lies on the Deccan Trap lava, so its predominant soil is black soil. Alluvial, red and laterite soils are not dominant there.

s: What is the number of union territories in India ?
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (8); it is added as option 5.
7 UTs in 2010 (printed key) — now 8 UTs since 26 Jan 2020 (J&K and Ladakh created 31 Oct 2019; DNH and Daman & Diu merged) (MHA).
India now has 8 UTs (since 26 Jan 2020): Delhi, Chandigarh, Puducherry, Lakshadweep, A&N, DNH and DD, J&K, Ladakh. In 2010 the answer was 7 (printed key); 9 was true only from 31 Oct 2019 to 26 Jan 2020, and 5 and 11 were never right.

src: APPSC Deputy Inspector of Survey, Technical Assistant in AP
s: There are ____ revenue divisions in Telangana.
x:
about 73 revenue divisions when asked — now 74 (Wikipedia list of revenue divisions in Telangana)
Telangana had about 73 revenue divisions in 33 districts when this was asked (c. 2020); 13, 128 and 33 are wrong (33 is the district count). Now 74.

src: Inspector of Factories, Civil Assistant Surgeons & Fisheries
s: As per Census, 2011, in one of the following states, the gap between male and female literacy rate is less than 5%?
x: Meghalaya's gap was only about 3 points (male about 76%, female about 73%); J&K, AP and Assam had gaps well above 5 points.

s: Zimbabwe was earlier known as
x: Zimbabwe was Southern Rhodesia (Rhodesia); Gold Coast was Ghana and Belgian Congo the DR Congo.

s: Which of the following mountain peak is not situated in Eastern Ghats?
x: Salher (Maharashtra) is a Western Ghats peak; Gali Konda, Sinkram Gutta and Madugula Konda are Eastern Ghats peaks.

src: APPSC Assistant Director in AP Economic & Statistics General
s: Which of the following villages overcame water crisis by building check dams and tanks?
x: Ralegan Siddhi in Ahmednagar district, Maharashtra (Anna Hazare), overcame its water crisis with check dams, tanks and watershed work; Hiware Bazar is a similar model.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Animal Husbandry Assist
s: The following being the result of the granites erosion as the formation of round boulders in many parts of Andhra Pradesh
x: Tors are the rounded granite boulders left standing when granite is weathered and eroded along its joints, a common sight in Andhra Pradesh. Fossils, crystals and particles are not landforms.

src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector General Studies & Me
s: As per an Atomic Minerals Directorate for Exploration and Research press release of March 2017, Andhra Pradesh has nearly 1.22 lakh tonnes of Uranium oxide, which is equal to nearly ______ tonnes of Uranium metal.
x: U3O8 is about 84.8% uranium by mass (714/842), so 1.22 lakh t of oxide ≈ 1.04 lakh t of uranium metal.

s: Macaroni wheat is grown in
x: Macaroni (durum) wheat is grown in the black-soil areas of central India – Maharashtra, MP, Karnataka – not Punjab, Haryana or UP.

s: Which of the following is not the man-made disaster?
x: Mud slides are a natural (geological) hazard. Food poisoning and deforestation come from human action, and epidemics are spread by human contact, so mud slides is the one not man-made.

s: Which of the following Indian states is vulnerable to Tsunamis?
x: Andhra Pradesh, with a long east coast facing the Bay of Bengal, is tsunami-prone (2004 tsunami); the others are landlocked.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s:

x: Lima is the capital of Peru; Lisbon and Madrid are Portugal's and Spain's.

src: APPSC Assistant B.C. & Tribal Welfare Officers Mains Paper-I

x: Yanadi, Sugali and Erukala are plains STs of AP; Boya is a BC community, not a plains tribe.

x: Neelam is a mango variety, not an arhar variety, so the arhar pair is wrong; the groundnut, lentil and mustard pairs are correct.

src: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer & Other Posts General St

x: In September 2021 the Adani Group (Adani Ports and SEZ) completed acquiring Gangavaram Port in Visakhapatnam district for about Rs 6,200 crore for the remaining stake.

src: APPSC Group-I Preliminary Paper-I General Studies 2023
s:
Which among the following statements are true about Indian Steel Industry?

I. India is the second largest producer of steel in the world

II. Indian steel industry produced 51.89 million tonnes crude steel with 5.1% share in the total world production.

III. The production of steel in the year 2020 is more than the previous year

IV. India is ranked first in the production of crude steel
x: Statement I is true (India 2nd after China), while III (2020 output fell below 2019 because of COVID) and IV (India first) are false; every option except 'I and II' contains a false statement, so I and II.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies

x: Andhra Pradesh's longest inter-state boundary is with Telangana, the residuary boundary of the 2014 bifurcation. Off-topic (AP location and boundaries), moved.

s: Which of the following represents the correct sequence in descending order, of the four largest sugar producing States of India in 2015-16?
x: In 2015-16 Maharashtra led (about 8.4 MT), followed by UP, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, so option 1 is right.

x: Anamudi, Vandaravu and Perumal Malai (Palani hills) and Velliangiri (Coimbatore) are all in the Western Ghats.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: In which of the following places, boiling point of water would be higher compared to others?
x: Water boils at a higher temperature where air pressure is higher, that is, at the lowest altitude. Visakhapatnam is a sea-level port, Kolleru is a low inland delta lake, and Tirumala and Nanda Devi are high up. The intended answer is the sea-level city, Visakhapatnam (no official key found; Kolleru is also near sea level).

s: As per IMD, a 'Drought Year' occurs when the annual rainfall is less than the normal by
x: IMD calls a year an all-India drought year when the season's rainfall is more than 10% below normal (and over 20% of the area is affected).

s: In Alaska the Upland between Brooks Range and Alaska Range is called:
x: The Yukon Plateau (Yukon–Tanana upland) lies between the Brooks Range to the north and the Alaska Range to the south; the Great Basin is in Nevada–Utah, between the Rockies and the Sierra Nevada.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: Which of the following Districts of Andhra Pradesh has the lowest percentage of tribal population?
x: The reorganised West Godavari district (HQ Bhimavaram, 2022) lost its agency mandals to Eluru and has the lowest ST share of the options.

s: Sir Edwin Lutyens was the architect of the city of
x: Sir Edwin Lutyens was the chief architect of New Delhi; Chandigarh was the work of Le Corbusier (official key: Chandigarh).

s: Consider the following statements : Statement-I The soil in tropical rain forests is rich in nutrients. Statement-II The high temperature and moisture of tropical rain forests cause dead organic matter in the soil to decompose quickly. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
x: Rain-forest soils are poor in nutrients: heavy rain leaches them and the dense vegetation takes them up at once, so Statement-I is false. Statement-II is true: heat and moisture make dead organic matter decompose quickly.

s:
Consider the following statements.

I. Currently three waterways have been declared as the National Waterways of India.

II. The Sadiya-Dhubri stretch of river Brahmaputra is the longest National Waterway.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x:
only 3 NWs in 2008 — now 111 NWs under the National Waterways Act 2016, so today neither statement is correct (PMF Human & Economic Geography 02 p31)
In 2008 (before NW-4 and NW-5 were declared at the end of 2008) only three National Waterways existed, so statement I was correct; statement II is wrong because NW-1 Allahabad-Haldia (1,620 km) is longer than NW-2 Sadiya-Dhubri (891 km). (Now 111 NWs, so statement I is no longer true.)

s: Which state of the USA is also known as the ‘Blue Grass State’?
x: Kentucky is the 'Bluegrass State'; California is the Golden State, Montana the Treasure State, Texas the Lone Star State.

src: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors, Agriculture Office
s: Which of the following district of Andhra Pradesh touches the boundary of Chhattisgarh?
at: Polavaram district (East Godavari when asked, before the 2022 and 2025 reorganisations)
x:
East Godavari lost its agency mandals in the April 2022 reorganisation (to Alluri Sitharama Raju) and the Rampachodavaram–Chinturu area became Polavaram district on 31 Dec 2025 — now Polavaram district (en.wikipedia.org, Polavaram district)
Polavaram district (Rampachodavaram HQ; its Chinturu division faces Sukma in Chhattisgarh) now touches Chhattisgarh. When asked the answer was East Godavari; from April 2022 it was Alluri Sitharama Raju, until Polavaram district was carved out on 31 December 2025 (now Polavaram).

src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Typist in Prisons & Correctional

x: The 'Iconic Bridge' (cable-stayed) was proposed across the Krishna to link the Amaravati capital region with Vijayawada/NH-65.

s: In which tribe the kitchen called ‘Lal Bangala’ is found?
x: The 'Lal Bangla' – a sacred kitchen no outsider may enter – is a Bhunjia custom (Chhattisgarh, Odisha).

s: Where is Bandipur National Park situated?
x: Bandipur National Park (Karnataka) lies in the Western Ghats, next to Mudumalai and Wayanad.

s: What is the official language in Sri Lanka?
x: Sinhala (Simhalam) is the official language of Sri Lanka, together with Tamil; the other options are distorted names.

src: Welfare Organiser in AP Sainik Welfare Sub Services 2020

x: Visakhapatnam (Visakhapatnam Container Terminal) got the first direct service from South-East India to North Europe (IEX), also calling at the Mediterranean; the other options are minor or proposed ports.

s: Who was the first woman to reach twice on Mount Everest?
x: Santosh Yadav was the first woman to climb Mount Everest twice, in 1992 and 1993.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: Which of the following is the main reason for the disappointment of the verdict given by the justice Brijesh Kumar Tribunal to share Krishna waters
o: The verdict does not sanction fresh distribution among the four riparian states
The Tribunal revised its verdict in favour of non-Telugu States
The Tribunal did not give an opportunity to Andhra Pradesh and Telangana State to put forth their argument
The Tribunal imposed cuts in water utilization of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
x: The Telugu States were disappointed because the Brijesh Kumar Tribunal (2016) confined itself to AP–Telangana sharing and did not order a fresh distribution among all four riparian States.

src: APPSC Royalty Inspector, Agriculture Officer, Town Planning
s: In which State, the maximum drainage area of Krishna basin is located?
x: Karnataka holds the largest share of the Krishna basin (about 44%), ahead of Maharashtra, Telangana and AP.

s: Which among the following is not a operational airport of Madhya Pradesh?
x: Khajuraho, Jabalpur and Gwalior have operational airports; Panna does not.

s:
Which of the following Protected Areas are located in Cauvery basin?

A. Nagarhole National Park

B. Papikonda National Park

C. Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer Screening Test General Studies
s: Which of the following in not a reason for drought?
x: Low rainfall, groundwater depletion and rising temperatures cause drought. High soil salt concentration is a consequence of poor drainage and irrigation, not a cause of drought.

s: Macaroni wheat is most suitable under what conditions?
x: Macaroni (durum) wheat is hardy and suited to rainfed, low-moisture conditions, unlike bread wheat in highly irrigated fields.

s: Bikaner canal is taken off from the river.
x: The Bikaner canal (Gang canal) is taken off from the Sutlej at Hussainiwala (Ferozepur); not the Banas, Chambal or Yamuna.

s: The New silk Route connects the countries
x: As in the twin question, the New Silk Route (Chongqing-Duisburg) links China and Germany; the other options are wrong.

s: Which one among the following cities is called the zero-mile centre of India?
x: Nagpur, near the geographical centre of the country, has the British-era Zero Mile Stone from which distances were measured.

s: The coastline of Andhra Pradesh is from Icchapuram in the north to______in the south.
x: AP's coastline runs from Ichchapuram (Srikakulam) in the north to Tada (Tirupati district) in the south.

s: For the purpose of reducing wind forces on the roof during a cyclone, the best roof architecture of a building, out of the options below is

s: Identify the correct answer from the following.
o: Desert soils are best suited for paddy crop.
Black regur soils are best suited for greengram crop.
Sand and loamy soils are best suited for onion crop.
Red soils are best suited for cotton crop.
x: Onion grows best on sandy and loamy soils; desert soils do not suit paddy, black soils are best for cotton rather than green gram, and red soils do not suit cotton.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Village Horticulture As

AP's districts were reorganised in April 2022 — Arma Konda is now in Alluri Sitharama Raju district (app notes 5:84 sub 8).
Arma Konda (Sitamakonda) lay in Visakhapatnam district (now Alluri Sitharama Raju district, formed 2022).

src: APPSC Assistant Architectural Surveyor & Deputy Surveyor Gen

s: At what approximate speed Tsunamis can move on coastal plains?
x: A tsunami crosses the deep ocean at 700-850 km/h but slows sharply in shallow water; as it runs over coastal plains it moves at roughly 50 km/h (the printed key). The other options are just distractors close to it.

src: APPSC 2019 Various non Gazetted Posts Limited Recruitment

x: In the 13-district map Chittoor had the most mandals (66), ahead of Anantapur (63); now YSR Kadapa has the most (40).

s: In HDI Index, countries which have high human development, are kept above the
x:
Most books and keys: 0.800 (the old three-group scheme). Strictly, since HDR 2014 'High' starts at 0.700 and 0.800+ is 'Very High' (app notes 4:72 sub 2).

o: None of the above – all are grown in black soil
x:

s: State bird of Andhra Pradesh.

s:
Consider the following statements:

A. Households in all societies differentiate various household activities and responsibilities by gender.

B. For women, production and reproduction are two interlinked activities.

C. Much of the work women do, although productive, is unpaid.

D. Men have always played a minor role in domestic work; societies tending to assume that they have paid work outside the home.
x: All four statements follow the sociology of gendered work: tasks are divided by gender, production and reproduction interlink for women, much of their work is unpaid, and men have done little domestic work.

s: Identify the correct sentence from the following:
o: India's first cotton mill was set up in New Delhi.
South Korea is the biggest importer of raw cotton from India.
Gujarat is the first largest producer of cotton textiles in India.
Cotton textile industry is the largest organized modern industry in India.
x: Cotton textiles is the largest organised modern industry of India. India's first cotton mill was at Fort Gloster near Kolkata (1818), not New Delhi; Bangladesh and China, not South Korea, are the main buyers of Indian raw cotton; Gujarat leads in raw cotton, but the statement on cotton textiles is not the standard answer, while statement 4 is the textbook fact.

at: All three statements (a, b and c) are correct (Sriharikota was in Nellore district when asked; now Tirupati district)
